# Not A Fugazi Trader (NAFT)

> Independent broker reviews, scam alerts, trading signals, and trader education for forex, prop firms, and crypto markets.

Not A Fugazi Trader is a broker-review and trader-safety platform. We help traders verify brokers, compare trading conditions, spot scams, and learn to trade through structured guides and market analysis.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover top brokers, scam alerts, signals, and market insights.
- [About](/about): Who we are, why we built NAFT, and our mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the NAFT team.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use and disclaimer.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling.

## Research & Compare

- [Brokers](/brokers): Browse reviewed forex, crypto, and CFD brokers.
- [Broker Detail](/brokers/bullwaves): Example of a full broker review page.
- [Prop Firms](/prop-firms): Reviewed proprietary trading firms and funding challenges.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side broker comparison tool.
- [Calculators](/calculators): Trading and risk calculators.
- [Regulators](/regulators): Financial regulator directory and profiles.
- [Glossary](/glossary): Trading terminology reference.
